title: Don't use Effect Events to hide dependencies

slides.say: use effect event can feel like a way to silence the dependency list. It is not.
Here page url changes should log a new visit. Hiding it in an Effect Event means you miss those logs.
If a value should re-run the Effect, keep it as a dependency.

slides.text: Effect Events are only for logic that is truly an event fired from an Effect.
slides.say: Use Effect Events only for logic that genuinely should not re-trigger the Effect.
